about.heading: About
about.bio: I'm a final-year B.Tech CSE (Data Science) student at NIIT University, building end-to-end AI and ML systems rather than notebooks — an agentic RAG pipeline that audits insurance bills clause-by-clause with zero fabricated citations, a Kubernetes autoscaler that forecasts traffic and beats the stock autoscaler by 62% (and honestly reports where it didn't), and a customer analytics pipeline that turns raw transactions into ranked retention decisions. I care most about systems that measure their own claims instead of asserting them.

projects.name: Bill Auditor
projects.headline: Built an agentic RAG system that audits hospital bills against insurance policy documents line-by-line — zero fabricated clause citations across every test run, validated by 492 passing tests.
projects.description: Reads a hospital bill against the policy meant to pay it, checking each line against the insurer's actual policy document and citing the exact clause behind every deduction. Uses LangGraph agentic orchestration with hybrid dense+lexical retrieval (ChromaDB + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, and a strict rule that the LLM never does arithmetic — only Python does, so numbers stay verifiable.

projects.name: Predictive Autoscaling for Kubernetes
projects.headline: Designed a predictive Kubernetes autoscaler that forecasts traffic 60 seconds ahead, cutting p99 latency by 62% against the stock autoscaler — benchmarked across 15 controlled A/B test runs.
projects.description: Kubernetes' built-in autoscaler reacts only after CPU has already risen, and pods take 19 seconds to become useful. This forecasts request rate 60 seconds ahead using a quantile-regression LightGBM model and provisions capacity before load arrives — then proves it with a controlled A/B benchmark, honestly publishing a scenario where the approach initially lost, and the architectural fix that turned it into a 49% win. Published as an interactive report where every benchmark run can be scrubbed through second-by-second, so the claims can be checked rather than taken on trust.

projects.name: Customer Segmentation & Retention
projects.headline: Developed a customer segmentation and churn prediction pipeline processing 540K+ transactions into ranked retention actions, flagging 229 high-value customers worth £16.5K in predicted revenue.
projects.description: Combines a value estimate (BG/NBD + Gamma-Gamma for 90-day predicted lifetime value) with a risk estimate (XGBoost churn prediction, 0.78 ROC-AUC) rather than using either alone, crossing them into a four-quadrant action matrix so a retention analyst gets a ranked, justified call list instead of a raw model score. Served via FastAPI backend and React dashboard.
